text_block_list.text:
Bubblyland is an eccentric pool resort
themed around the fun
atmosphere of
Japan's late '80s bubble era.

Here, everyone liberates themselves in
their desire to experience the passion and
brilliance of the good ol' days and a
taste of the
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's podiums to dance on, tiramisu and
nata de coco at the cafe,
mochi by the
pool, and a giant waterslide to enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You can rent retro clothes over there?!
Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at those cars! Their bodies are
set so low to the ground!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, hang on!
This isn't a training facility at
all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Wait... Don't tell me you tricked me into coming here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you! There's no way I would do such a
thing to my cute little
junior! It's true that
this place can help turn your bad vibes
into good ones!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just let yourself get carried away by the
party fever, and you'll
understand soon
enough! Anyway, let's change into our
swimsuits!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa! W-wait a second!

Meanwhile, on Daiwa Scarlet's side of
things...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh! Where's all the magic?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Calm down a little! Ugh, how did I even
get dragged into this?!

For some reason, she ended up at
Bubblyland too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll do two laps around the track this morning... No, I'll do four! I don't care what it takes— I will get back to normal by this weekend!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Spe and Tickezo, you two'd better hold on
tight! You're gonna
experience the most
amazing magic at Bubblyland!

text_block_list.name: Spe and Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!
Vrooom...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Bubblyland... Oh, that's the place Maruzen
invited me to yesterday. I
hope Spe can
get some good training in there...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Did she say magic?! I just heard something
about the most amazing
magic! They all
looked so excited, it's got to be magic!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She did say that, but it's just a—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to that Bubbly whatchamacallit
place too! No one can stop
me!

Sweep Tosho runs as fast as she can after
the rental car.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait, is she seriously planning on running there?! You've got to be kidding!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Oh my gosh, she's running at full tilt...
Wait, does she even know how to get to
that place? If she loses sight of the car,
she'll be completely
lost...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! Hang on, Sweep! Wait up!

One thing leads to another, and Daiwa
Scarlet ends up chasing
Sweep Tosho all
the way to Bubblyland.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I never expected we'd have to go over three mountains. That was more intense than any training session! ...But that's not important!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sweep. Listen to me carefully. The
whole "magical land" thing
was just a
metaphor. Magic doesn't really exist.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It does too! My grandma's able to use it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-no, that's not what I—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's definitely magic here!
If you don't
believe me, then I'll just
have to find it and
prove you wrooong!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Wait! Aw, I was planning to take her
straight home once I caught
up to her!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I should just leave, and—no, I
can't! An honor student can't
just abandon
someone who chased after a car all this
way!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... Ugh, come on!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is ridiculous!
I have to hurry back and
train!
